<a id="frequency"></a>

### frequency

```ts
frequency: number;
```

Spatial frequency of the noise; larger values produce smaller features. Defaults to 1.

***

<a id="lacunarity"></a>

### lacunarity

```ts
lacunarity: number;
```

Frequency multiplier between successive noise octaves. Defaults to 2.

***

<a id="octaves"></a>

### octaves

```ts
octaves: number;
```

Number of noise layers; additional layers increase sampling work. Defaults to 1.

***

<a id="offset"></a>

### offset

```ts
offset: Vector3;
```

Spatial noise offset, independent of the particle position.

***

<a id="persistence"></a>

### persistence

```ts
persistence: number;
```

Amplitude multiplier between successive noise octaves. Defaults to 0.5.

***

<a id="priority"></a>

### priority?

```ts
optional priority?: number;
```

Execution phase: negative is permanent before movement, 0–1 is transient before movement, 1 or greater is transient after movement.
